subject: Typography
label: WEBSITE READABILITY
caption: If your website is hard to read, it's hard to buy from. Most business owners use default template settings without realizing they are driving mobile users away. Try the daylight test today and fix your contrast, width, and fonts to keep prospects on your page. #webdesign #typography #smallbusinesswebsite #usability #conversionrate

slides.title: Poor website readability is costing you sales.
slides.body: If prospects struggle to read your pricing or services, they click away. Here are four common typography mistakes that are quietly killing your website conversions right now.

slides.title: Stop using light gray text on white.
slides.body: Many modern templates default to light gray body text. Outside in daylight or on older mobile screens, it becomes completely invisible. Switch your body text to dark gray or black.

slides.title: Your paragraphs are too wide to read.
slides.body: If your text stretches across the entire desktop screen, users will skip it. Limit your text blocks to about 60–80 characters per line to make reading your offers effortless.

slides.title: Limit your website to two fonts.
slides.body: Using three or more fonts slows down your page load speed and looks disorganized. Use one clean font for headings and one for body text to instantly look more professional.

slides.title: Test your website readability in 10 seconds.
slides.body: Open your homepage on your phone, step outside into daylight, and try to read it. If you have to squint, your customers are already leaving. Save this post to audit your fonts.
